project.description:
The workbenches a library author runs against their own articles.
The reader is for a child and ships to a family's device. The studio is for whoever builds Kranji and holds internal tooling. This is the third seat: somebody who writes and curates a reading library and wants to see it exactly as the reader will - the same widgets, the same routes - beside tools that measure it.
WHAT IS HERE IS THE BENCH, NOT THE LIBRARY. It declares no articles and mounts none. A library repository adds a small module that depends on this one and on its own collections, and that module is where the real articles arrive - the same way they reach the reader, by discovery, so a workbench run there sees what a reader would.
It depends on the reading app and composes its widgets; it does not depend on the studio, which the dependency-direction rule forbids for every module but the packaging one. Whatever the studio holds that a library author needs will have to move somewhere both can reach.
